title: Spend A only if B is co-spent
author: Aaron Zhang (Aaron Recompile)
summary: A tapscript construction that binds a spend to a specific second UTXO through sha_prevouts, using only OP_CAT and OP_CHECKSIGFROMSTACK. One signature passes both CSFS and CHECKSIG, so the script can read the real transaction.
does_not_show: A signet experiment, not a bridge implementation.
Assumes SIGHASH_DEFAULT, no annex and a script-path spend (the fixed 212-byte preimage layout).
Same-signature binding needs a participating signer; keyless covenants are out of scope.
